applicationid.description: The optional applicationid. Required for PAG resource types.

applicationsecret.description: The optional applicationsecret. Required for PAG resource types.

customerid.description: The optional customerID. If not provided, the provider will attempt to discover.

password.description: The JSC password used for authentication.

username.description: The JSC username used for authentication. Must be local account - SSO or SAML not supported.

app_template_id.description: ID of the SaaS app template to base this policy on (e.g., from jsc_app_template data source). When set, hostnames are inherited from the template.

assignmentallusers.description: Assign this ZTNA app policy to all users.

assignmentgroups.description: List of group IDs to assign this ZTNA app policy to.

bareips.description: List of bare IPs in IPv4 CIDR notation.

hostnames.description: List of hostnames to route through this ZTNA policy.

name.description: The name of the ZTNA App. Must be unique across the tenant.

routingdnstype.description: DNS IP resolution type. IPv4 or IPv6. Ignored when routingtype is DIRECT.

routingid.description: The VPN route ID. Required when routingtype is CUSTOM. Obtain from jsc_pag_vpnroutes datasource.

routingtype.description: Routing type. CUSTOM routes via a specific VPN route; DIRECT routes without a relay.

securitydevicemanagementbasedaccessenabl.description: Enable device management based access control.

securitydevicemanagementbasedaccessnotif.description: Enable notifications for device management based access events.

securitydohintegrationblocking.description: Enable DNS-over-HTTPS blocking for this app policy.

securitydohintegrationnotifications.description: Enable notifications for DoH integration events.

securityriskcontrolenabled.description: Enable device risk controls for this app policy.

securityriskcontrolnotifications.description: Enable notifications for risk control events.

securityriskcontrolthreshold.description: Risk level threshold for access. Valid values: HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW.

type.description: The app type. Use ENTERPRISE for SwiftConnect routing.

block.description: Per-group routing overrides. Allows different routing configurations for specific device groups within the same policy.

name.description: Display name for the admin account.

notification_categories.description: Notification categories to subscribe to. Known values: SECURITY, MOBILE_DATA, SERVICE_MANAGEMENT.

permissions.description: Permissions granted to the admin. Not required if role is SUPER_ADMIN. Known values: DEVICES, ACCESS, SETTINGS, SECURITY, AUDIT_LOGS, USER_SUMMARY, CHANGE_PASSWORD_IN_RADAR.

roles.description: Roles assigned to the admin. Empty set = read-only. Known elevated roles: SUPER_ADMIN, GLOBAL_ADMIN, MAGIC.

sso_enabled.description: Whether SSO is enabled for this admin account. Defaults to false (local auth).

username.description: Username (email address) for the admin account. Changing this forces a new resource.

idptype.description: Allowed values of 'Okta', 'None, or 'NetworkRelay'. If NetworkRelay is selected, only Private Access will be enabled

oktaconnectionid.description: Okta Connection ID. Required when idptype is set to OKTA

type.description: Type of block page. 'cap' for Data Cap, 'secureBlock' for Security Block, 'deviceRisk' for Device Risk Block, 'deviceManagement' for lack of MDM block

consent_url.description: Microsoft OAuth consent URL generated after connection creation. Visit this URL in a browser to complete IdP setup.

name.description: Display name for the Entra IdP connection.

state.description: Current state of the IdP connection. INITIAL until Microsoft OAuth consent is completed, then APPROVED.

a.description: Set (unordered list) of IPv4 A records

aaaa.description: Set (unordered list) of IPv6 A records

assignmentallusers.description: Assign ZTNA App to all users

assignmentgroups.description: Group IDs to assign ZTNA App Policy

bareips.description: List of bare ips - IPv4 only CIDR notation

categoryname.description: Category Name - supported types are Adult, Advertising, App Counters, App Stores, Audio & Music, Browsers, Business & Industry, Cloud & File Storage, Communication, Content Servers, Custom, Entertainment, Extreme, Finance, Gambling, Games, Generative AI, Illegal, Lifestyle, Medical, Navigation, News & Sport, OS Updates, Productivity, Reference, Shopping, Social, Technology, Travel, Uncategorized, Video & Photo

hostnames.description: List of hostnames. Must be unique across all Access Policies and App Templates

id.description: The unique identifier of the ZTNA App datasource set from JSC

name.description: The name of the ZTNA App. Must be unique

routingdnstype.description: Routing IP DNS Resolution Type - IPv4 or IPv6 (default is IPv6)

routingid.description: Routing ID - required when routingtype is CUSTOM. Otherwise must be omitted
